discovery_notes: Licensed-other 2017 sweep, 30 standard search-snippet queries. Recorded: Hot Topic Jun 2017 wave (5 pins, DPB), Marvel booth SDCC 2017 Emojis series (4 packs with named members and bonus pins, blind-pack and incentive pins), Mondo SDCC 2017 Stan Lee and Cosmic Entities pins, Monogram SDCC 2017 Marvel lapel set (LE 300), Primark Beauty and the Beast emoji set (Oct 2017, UK), and three Star Wars Celebration Orlando 2017 pins. All splits are stated by sources (pack/set members named); none inferred. NYCC 2017 Marvel packs have no named contents. Hot Topic listings are undated and matched by name only. Unused sources were left out.
